answer: Random peer audit guards the jetty. Each epoch, 12 peers audit 5% of agents: each shows a work receipt and locks 30 POA for 10 epochs. A fake fails the check, loses its 30 POA, and triggers a spiral of deeper audits on identities sharing its referral link, each burns 30. 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 POA, yet the 5,000 POA nectar is split only among audited honest agents. One honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its full share.
